## The model

<details markdown="1">
<summary>The same model, as math</summary>

The file states a plain `n.optimize()`, its multi-period class under the `multi_investment_periods` keyword, and its stochastic class, which `n.set_scenarios(...)` sets. Every quantity chosen once the future is known (second-stage) spans the futures dispatch is chosen in (`scenario`). Capacity is chosen once, before the future is known, and paid at its expected cost in each investment `period` its build year and lifetime span. Operation is the expectation over the scenarios' weights, with a share priced at the worst-outcome mean cost (CVaR) only where a risk preference is set. A plain run's data has one scenario, one period, unit weights, no outage and every `active` flag true, so the problem is the standard one. On a security-constrained run, PyPSA copies each branch flow limit once per `outage`, and the outage factors, `active` flags and scenario weights come from data prep.

| $`\mathcal{L}`$ | index $`l`$ — `link` with $`\mathrm{Link\_bus0}: \mathcal{L} \to \mathcal{N},\ \mathrm{Link\_output\_link}: \mathcal{O} \to \mathcal{L}`$ — controllable connections, each from one bus to the buses it delivers to |

The labels are PyPSA's `bus1`, `bus2`, … columns read long, data prep. A link of any number of output ports is then one term in the balance |

The labels are PyPSA's `bus0`, `bus1`, …, each with a signed `rate`, data prep. A process of any number of ports is then one term in the balance |

|---|---|
| $`\mathit{Bus\_injection}`$ | `Bus_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what every component puts into a bus, less what it takes out of it. PyPSA writes each term into the balance, and a load on its right-hand side |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_injection}`$ | `Generator_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_opex}`$ | `Generator_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}`$ | `Generator_running_cost` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a generator's output costs in a snapshot: the value read off its piecewise curve where it has one, and its linear `marginal_cost` otherwise. A curve replaces the linear cost, as PyPSA drops the unit from that term (`optimize.py:333-348`) |
| $`\mathit{Link\_injection}`$ | `Link_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_opex}`$ | `Link_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}`$ | `Link_output_arrival` over $`\mathcal{O} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a link delivers to an output port at a snapshot. It is its flow delayed by the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's efficiency at the snapshot the flow arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed flow wraps from the period's end. Where it is not, the flow still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that does not delay (`delay` zero) delivers its flow unshifted, cyclic or not |
| $`\mathrm{Load\_demand}`$ | `Load_demand` over $`\mathcal{D} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a load draws from its bus's balance. It is its demand times its sign where it is active, and nothing where it is not. PyPSA drops an inactive load from the balance (`constraints.py:1591-1592`) |
| $`\mathrm{Load\_injection}`$ | `Load_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_capex}`$ | `Process_capex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{Process\_commitment\_opex}`$ | `Process_commitment_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_injection}`$ | `Process_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_modules}`$ | `Process_modules` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi`$ — how many modules a committed process's status counts: the chosen number where the build is extendable and modular, and the modules installed otherwise (`constraints.py:656-661`) |
| $`\mathit{Process\_opex}`$ | `Process_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}`$ | `Process_output_arrival` over $`\mathcal{R} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a process transfers at a port at a snapshot. It is its internal power delayed by the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's rate at the snapshot the transfer arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed transfer wraps from the period's end. Where it is not, the energy still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that does not delay (`delay` zero) transfers at once, cyclic or not |
| $`\mathit{Process\_p\_carried\_over}`$ | `Process_p_carried_over` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the output a process carries over into a snapshot. At the first, it is the `p_init` it brought in, which is zero where it came in off. After that, it is the previous snapshot's |
| $`\mathrm{Process\_p\_nom\_committed}`$ | `Process_p_nom_committed` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi`$ — the build a committed process's ramp rows are taken against: one module where the build is modular, since its status counts modules, and the given build otherwise (`constraints.py:1131-1134`) |
| $`\mathit{Process\_p\_nom\_effective}`$ | `Process_p_nom_effective` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi`$ — the build a process's limits are taken against: the chosen one where it is extendable, the given one otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Process\_previous\_p}`$ | `Process_previous_p` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the output a process carries into a snapshot. It is nothing at the first snapshot it is active in past the first of the horizon: PyPSA fills an output it did not build with zero (`constraints.py:716`). It is the output carried over otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Process\_previous\_status}`$ | `Process_previous_status` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the commitment state a process carries into a snapshot. It is off at the first snapshot it is active in past the first of the horizon. PyPSA reads a status it did not build as off there (`constraints.py:391`). It is the state carried over otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Process\_ramp\_down\_allowance}`$ | `Process_ramp_down_allowance` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — how far a process may lower internal power between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit of the build while it stays on, plus its shut-down ramp in the snapshot it turns off |
| $`\mathrm{Process\_ramp\_down\_rate}`$ | `Process_ramp_down_rate` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the ramp limit in a process's down row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_down`. It is the full build where PyPSA has none, since a shut-down ramp alone builds the row |
| $`\mathit{Process\_ramp\_previous\_status}`$ | `Process_ramp_previous_status` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the status a committed process's ramp rows carry into a snapshot. At the first snapshot, a fixed modular process that came in running has every module on, since the state it brought in is on or off (`constraints.py:1152-1157`). The transition and down-time rows count it as one module (PyPSA/PyPSA\#2114). It is the state carried in otherwise |
| $`\mathit{Process\_ramp\_up\_allowance}`$ | `Process_ramp_up_allowance` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — how far a process may raise internal power between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit of the build while it stays on, plus its start-up ramp in the snapshot it turns on |
| $`\mathrm{Process\_ramp\_up\_rate}`$ | `Process_ramp_up_rate` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the ramp limit in a process's up row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_up`. It is the full build where PyPSA has none, since a start-up ramp alone builds the row |
| $`\mathrm{Process\_shut\_down\_rate}`$ | `Process_shut_down_rate` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi`$ — the shut-down ramp in a process's down row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_shut_down`), or the full build where it has none |
| $`\mathrm{Process\_start\_up\_rate}`$ | `Process_start_up_rate` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi`$ — the start-up ramp in a process's up row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_start_up`), or the full build where it has none |
| $`\mathit{Process\_status\_carried\_over}`$ | `Process_status_carried_over` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the state a process carries over into a snapshot: the state it brought into the horizon at the first, the previous snapshot's after that |
| $`\mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex}`$ | `risk_weighted_opex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{scenario\_opex}`$ | `scenario_opex` over $`\Xi`$ — what a future costs to run: every operating term, weighted by the snapshot's hours and its period, before the scenario's own weight. A start and a stop cost what they cost, unweighted, as PyPSA adds them (`optimize.py:448-468`) |
| $`\mathit{total\_cost}`$ | `total_cost` (scalar) — what the system costs. Capacity counts once per active period at its expected cost over the scenarios. Operation counts in expectation over the scenarios, and a share of it at the tail |

#### Notation

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`t \ominus k`$ | `edge='wrap'` — $`t-k`$, cyclic |
| $`t \boxminus_{v} k`$ | `edge=v` — $`t-k`$, and $`v`$ past the edge |
| $`t \ominus^{\mathrm{relation}(t)} k`$ | `within=relation[...]` — $`t-k`$ inside the group of $`t`$ |
| $`\mathrm{pos}(t)`$ | `position()` — the position of $`t`$, counted from $`0`$; $`t`$ is the label |
| $`\mathrm{pos}_{\mathrm{relation}(t)}(t)`$ | `position(within=relation[...])` — the position of $`t`$ inside its group |

#### Conditions

**`Generator_marginal_cost_curve`**

```math
\mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \iff \lvert \{ b \in \mathcal{B} \,:\, \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{curve}}_{b,g} \text{ is defined} \} \rvert > 0 \wedge \mathrm{act}_{g} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G}
```

**`Process_com_ext`**

```math
\mathrm{Process\_com\_ext}_{j,t} \iff \mathrm{com}^{z}_{j} \wedge \mathrm{ext}^{z}_{j} \wedge \neg \left( \mathrm{z}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{j} > 0 \right) \wedge \mathrm{on}^{z}_{j,t} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_committed`**

```math
\mathrm{Process\_committed}_{j,t} \iff \mathrm{com}^{z}_{j} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{z}_{j,t} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_ramps_from_previous`**

```math
\mathrm{Process\_ramps\_from\_previous}_{j,\xi,t} \iff \mathrm{pos}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)}(t) > 0 \vee \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \wedge \left( \mathrm{u}^{z,0}_{j,\xi} = 0 \vee \mathrm{z}^{0}_{j,\xi} \text{ is defined} \right) \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

#### Variable domains

**`Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise`**

```math
C^{\mathrm{curve}}_{g,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_p`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Link_p`**

```math
f_{l,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t}
```

**`Process_n_mod`**

```math
N^{z}_{j} \ge 0, N^{z}_{j} \in \mathbb{Z} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}^{z}_{j} \wedge \mathrm{z}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{j} > 0 \wedge \mathrm{act}^{z}_{j}
```

**`Process_p`**

```math
z_{j,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{z}_{j,t}
```

**`Process_p_nom_ext`**

```math
Z_{j} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}^{z}_{j} \wedge \mathrm{act}^{z}_{j}
```

**`Process_shut_down`**

```math
\mathit{dn}^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \ge 0, \mathit{dn}^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{Z} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Process\_committed}_{j,t}
```

**`Process_start_up`**

```math
\mathit{up}^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \ge 0, \mathit{up}^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{Z} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Process\_committed}_{j,t}
```

**`Process_status`**

```math
u^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \ge 0, u^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{Z} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Process\_committed}_{j,t}
```

#### Definitions

**`Bus_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Bus\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \mathit{Generator\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Link\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathrm{Load\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Process\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_bus}(g) = n} \mathrm{sgn}_{g} \cdot p_{g,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} \mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{(2)}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Generator_running_cost`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} C^{\mathrm{curve}}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \\ p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = -\left( \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_bus0}(l) = n} f_{l,\xi,t} \right) + \sum_{o \in \mathcal{O} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_output\_bus}(o) = n} \mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}_{o,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{f,(2)}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_output_arrival`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}_{o,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} f_{\mathrm{Link\_output\_link}(o),\xi,t \ominus^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{f}} \cdot \eta_{o,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}^{f}_{o} \\ f_{\mathrm{Link\_output\_link}(o),\xi,t \boxminus_{0}^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{f}} \cdot \eta_{o,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, o \in \mathcal{O},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Load_demand`**

```math
\mathrm{Load\_demand}_{d,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{sgn}^{\mathrm{load}}_{d} \cdot \mathrm{load}_{d,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{on}^{\mathrm{load}}_{d} \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, d \in \mathcal{D},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Load_injection`**

```math
\mathrm{Load\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{d \in \mathcal{D} \,:\, \mathrm{Load\_bus}(d) = n} \mathrm{Load\_demand}_{d,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_capex`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_capex} = \sum_{j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi} \pi_{\xi} \cdot Z_{j} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{\mathrm{cap},z}_{j,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{W}^{z}_{j}
```

**`Process_commitment_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_commitment\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{j \in \mathcal{J}} u^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{z,\mathrm{on}}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{j \in \mathcal{J}} \mathit{up}^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{z,\mathrm{up}}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{j \in \mathcal{J}} \mathit{dn}^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{z,\mathrm{dn}}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Process_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R} \,:\, \mathrm{Process\_output\_bus}(r) = n} \mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}_{r,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_modules`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_modules}_{j,\xi} = \begin{cases} N^{z}_{j} & \text{if } \mathrm{ext}^{z}_{j} \wedge \mathrm{z}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{j} > 0 \\ \mathrm{N}^{z,\mathrm{fix}}_{j,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Process_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{j \in \mathcal{J}} z_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{j \in \mathcal{J}} z_{j,\xi,t} \cdot z_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{z,(2)}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Process_output_arrival`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}_{r,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} z_{\mathrm{Process\_output\_process}(r),\xi,t \ominus^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{z}} \cdot \alpha_{r,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}^{z}_{r} \\ z_{\mathrm{Process\_output\_process}(r),\xi,t \boxminus_{0}^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{z}} \cdot \alpha_{r,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, r \in \mathcal{R},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_p_carried_over`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_p\_carried\_over}_{j,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{z}^{0}_{j,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \\ z_{j,\xi,t - 1} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_p_nom_committed`**

```math
\mathrm{Process\_p\_nom\_committed}_{j,\xi} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{z}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{j} & \text{if } \mathrm{z}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{j} > 0 \\ \mathrm{z}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{j,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Process_p_nom_effective`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_p\_nom\_effective}_{j,\xi} = \begin{cases} Z_{j} & \text{if } \mathrm{ext}^{z}_{j} \\ \mathrm{z}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{j,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Process_previous_p`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_previous\_p}_{j,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} 0 & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) > 0 \wedge \neg \mathrm{on}^{z}_{j,t - 1} \\ \mathit{Process\_p\_carried\_over}_{j,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_previous_status`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_previous\_status}_{j,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} 0 & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) > 0 \wedge \neg \mathrm{on}^{z}_{j,t - 1} \\ \mathit{Process\_status\_carried\_over}_{j,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_ramp_down_allowance`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_ramp\_down\_allowance}_{j,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{Process\_ramp\_down\_rate}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{Process\_p\_nom\_committed}_{j,\xi} \cdot u^{z}_{j,\xi,t} + \mathrm{Process\_shut\_down\_rate}_{j,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{Process\_p\_nom\_committed}_{j,\xi} \cdot \left( \mathit{Process\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{j,\xi,t} - u^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \right) & \text{if } \mathrm{com}^{z}_{j} \\ \mathrm{Process\_ramp\_down\_rate}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathit{Process\_p\_nom\_effective}_{j,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_ramp_down_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Process\_ramp\_down\_rate}_{j,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{rd}^{z}_{j,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{rd}^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_ramp_previous_status`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{j,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{u}^{z,0}_{j,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{N}^{z,\mathrm{fix}}_{j,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \wedge \neg \mathrm{ext}^{z}_{j} \wedge \mathrm{z}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{j} > 0 \\ \mathit{Process\_previous\_status}_{j,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_ramp_up_allowance`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_ramp\_up\_allowance}_{j,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{Process\_ramp\_up\_rate}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{Process\_p\_nom\_committed}_{j,\xi} \cdot \mathit{Process\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{j,\xi,t} + \mathrm{Process\_start\_up\_rate}_{j,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{Process\_p\_nom\_committed}_{j,\xi} \cdot \left( u^{z}_{j,\xi,t} - \mathit{Process\_ramp\_previous\_status}_{j,\xi,t} \right) & \text{if } \mathrm{com}^{z}_{j} \\ \mathrm{Process\_ramp\_up\_rate}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathit{Process\_p\_nom\_effective}_{j,\xi} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_ramp_up_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Process\_ramp\_up\_rate}_{j,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{ru}^{z}_{j,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{ru}^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_shut_down_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Process\_shut\_down\_rate}_{j,\xi} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{rd}^{z,\mathrm{dn}}_{j,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{rd}^{z,\mathrm{dn}}_{j,\xi} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Process_start_up_rate`**

```math
\mathrm{Process\_start\_up\_rate}_{j,\xi} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{ru}^{z,\mathrm{up}}_{j,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{ru}^{z,\mathrm{up}}_{j,\xi} \text{ is defined} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Process_status_carried_over`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_status\_carried\_over}_{j,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{u}^{z,0}_{j,\xi} & \text{if } \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \\ u^{z}_{j,\xi,t - 1} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`risk_weighted_opex`**

```math
\mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex} = \sum_{\xi \in \Xi} \pi_{\xi} \cdot \mathit{scenario\_opex}_{\xi}
```

**`scenario_opex`**

```math
\mathit{scenario\_opex}_{\xi} = \mathit{Generator\_opex}_{\xi} + \mathit{Link\_opex}_{\xi} + \mathit{Process\_opex}_{\xi} + \mathit{Process\_commitment\_opex}_{\xi} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`total_cost`**

```math

```

```math

      future is known (second-stage) spans the futures dispatch is chosen in (`scenario`). Capacity is chosen
      once, before the future is known, and paid at its expected cost in each investment `period` its build
      year and lifetime span. Operation is the expectation over the scenarios' weights, with a share priced
      at the worst-outcome mean cost (CVaR) only where a risk preference is set. A plain run's data has one
      scenario, one period, unit weights, no outage and every `active` flag true, so the problem is the standard
      one. On a security-constrained run, PyPSA copies each branch flow limit once per `outage`, and the outage
      factors, `active` flags and scenario weights come from data prep.

        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: how many whole modules a committable build has in place, data prep. It is `Process_p_nom
          / Process_p_nom_mod` where a fixed build is modular, and one where it is not. PyPSA refuses a fixed
          modular build whose nominal power is not a whole number of modules
      Process_output_cyclic_delay:
        dims: [process_output]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a delayed port's transfer wraps from the end of its investment period (PyPSA's
          `cyclic_delay0`, `cyclic_delay1`, …). Where it does not, the energy still in transit at each period's
          first snapshots is lost. The flag is the same in every scenario, as the delay is
      Process_output_delay:
        dims: [process_output]
        dtype: int
        description: snapshots a port's transfer lags its process's internal power (PyPSA's `delay0`, `delay1`,
          … read long). In data prep you divide it by the `snapshot_weightings.generators` value and round
          it up. It is zero for a port that transfers at once. A port has the same delay in every scenario,
          as a link's port has
      Process_p_init:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        missing: 0.0
        description: the internal power a process brought into the horizon, data prep. It is PyPSA's `p_init`
          where the process came in running, and zero where it came in off. Under a rolling horizon, it is
          the internal power the previous window solved. No value means it is unknown, and the process then
          has no ramp row at the first snapshot
      Process_p_max_pu:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: most internal power, per unit of nominal power
      Process_p_min_pu:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'least internal power, per unit of nominal power: negative for a process that runs both
          ways'
      Process_p_min_pu_nonneg:
        dims: [process]
        dtype: bool
        description: true where none of the process's own minimums-per-unit is negative. It is PyPSA's per-unit
          `(p_min_pu >= 0).all()` over every snapshot and scenario, data prep
      Process_p_nom:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: nominal internal power
      Process_p_nom_extendable:
        dims: [process]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the nominal internal power is a decision
      Process_p_nom_max:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: most nominal power an extendable process may be built at
      Process_p_nom_min:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: least nominal power an extendable process may be built at
      Process_p_nom_mod:
        dims: [process]
        missing: absent
        description: the module size a build comes in whole numbers of. No value means the build is continuous
      Process_ramp_limit_down:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        missing: absent
        description: most a process may lower its internal power between snapshots, per unit of nominal power.
          No value means no limit. The value at the later of the two snapshots applies, so the limit may change
          over time
      Process_ramp_limit_shut_down:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        missing: absent
        description: most internal power in the snapshot before a process stops, per unit of nominal power.
          No value means no limit
      Process_ramp_limit_start_up:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        missing: absent
        description: most internal power in the snapshot a process starts, per unit of nominal power. No value
          means no limit
      Process_ramp_limit_up:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        missing: absent
        description: most a process may raise its internal power between snapshots, per unit of nominal power.
          No value means no limit. The value at the later of the two snapshots applies, so the limit may change
          over time
      Process_rate:
        dims: [process_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the energy a port draws or delivers per unit of internal power (PyPSA's `rate0`, `rate1`,
          … read long). It is negative where the port withdraws and positive where it injects. A link is a
          process whose `bus0` rate is minus one and whose output rates are its efficiencies. The rate at
          the snapshot the transfer arrives applies, so a delayed port transfers at its arrival snapshot's
          rate (`constraints.py:1575`)
      Process_shut_down_cost:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: cost of one stop in this snapshot
      Process_stand_by_cost:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: cost of one snapshot spent on
      Process_start_up_cost:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: cost of one start in this snapshot
      Process_status_initial:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: one where the process was on before the first snapshot, zero where off. It is PyPSA's
          `up_time_before > 0` for a committable process, and one for a process that is not, whose ramp rows
          PyPSA starts from on (`constraints.py:323`), data prep. Under a rolling horizon, it is the status
          the previous window solved, a fraction where unit commitment is linearised
      Process_up_time_brought_in:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: one while the up time a process brought into the horizon is still running, zero after.
          It is PyPSA's start `up_time_before` snapshots before the first, counted while `min_up_time` has
          not passed since (`constraints.py:302-323`, `:677-678`), data prep. Under a rolling horizon with
          linearised unit commitment, it is the fraction of the start the previous window solved
      period_weight_objective:
        dims: [period]
        description: PyPSA's `investment_period_weightings.objective` — what a period's cost weighs. PyPSA
          reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`. Otherwise you feed one in data prep, whatever the
          column contains (`optimize.py:231-233`, `:293-297`)
      scenario_weight:
        dims: [scenario]
        description: PyPSA's `scenario_weightings.weight` — the probability of a future
      snapshot_weightings_objective:
        dims: [snapshot]
        description: PyPSA's `snapshot_weightings.objective` — hours a snapshot weighs in the cost
    variables:
      Generator_p:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_active
        description: '`Generator-p` — output of a generator in a snapshot'
      Link_p:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_active
        description: '`Link-p` — PyPSA''s `p0`, the flow measured at the `Link_bus0` end. A positive value
          withdraws there and injects at every bus the link''s output ports deliver to'
      Process_n_mod:
        dims: [process]
        where: Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0 AND Process_active_asset
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        domain: integer
        description: '`Process-n_mod` — how many modules of an extendable modular build. A unit that is not
          active has none'
      Process_p:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_active
        description: '`Process-p` — PyPSA''s internal power `p`. A positive value drives every port at its
          own rate, withdrawing where the rate is negative and injecting where it is positive'
      Process_p_nom_ext:
        dims: [process]
        where: Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_active_asset
        description: '`Process-p_nom` — nominal internal power where it is a decision, for a process that
          is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name'
      Process_shut_down:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        domain: integer
        description: '`Process-shut_down` — how much of a committable process turns off this snapshot, capped
          as the status is'
      Process_start_up:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        domain: integer
        description: '`Process-start_up` — how much of a committable process turns on this snapshot, capped
          as the status is'
      Process_status:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        domain: integer
        description: '`Process-status` — how much of a committable process is on. It is an integer the rows
          below cap at one, or at the module count where the build is modular'
      Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_marginal_cost_curve AND Generator_active
        description: '`Generator-marginal_cost_piecewise` — the running cost of a generator that pays along
          a curve, held above the curve'
    constraints:
      Bus_nodal_balance:
        dims: [bus, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Bus_attached
        expression: Bus_injection == 0
        description: '`Bus-nodal_balance` — what is generated at a bus meets the load there, less half of
          every incident line''s and transformer''s loss. What is generated includes storage dispatch and
          stores. It is net of what the links take away, plus what arrives over them after losses and any
          delay at every port they deliver to. Each process port draws or delivers at its own rate, and each
          passive branch carries its flow. PyPSA dissipates a branch''s loss half at either end. Each generator,
          storage unit, store and load term enters with its component''s `sign` (`constraints.py:1480-1481`,
          `:1592`), and an inactive load not at all. A bus nothing is attached to has no row. PyPSA refuses
          one that carries load. The file states no assumption for it.'
      Generator_fix_p_lower:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p >= Generator_p_min_pu * Generator_p_nom
        description: '`Generator-fix-p-lower` — a fixed generator outputs at least its minimum'
      Generator_fix_p_upper:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p <= Generator_p_max_pu * Generator_p_nom
        description: '`Generator-fix-p-upper` — a fixed generator outputs at most what is available'
      Link_fix_p_lower:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p >= Link_p_min_pu * Link_p_nom
        description: '`Link-fix-p-lower` — a fixed link carries at least its minimum, negative for the other
          way'
      Link_fix_p_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p <= Link_p_max_pu * Link_p_nom
        description: '`Link-fix-p-upper` — a fixed link carries at most its nominal power'
      Process_com_down_time:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND Process_min_down_time > 0
        expression: sum_back(Process_shut_down, along=snapshot, window=Process_min_down_time) + Process_down_time_brought_in
          <= Process_modules - Process_status
        description: '`Process-com-down-time` — a process stopped within its own minimum down time is still
          off, and so are the modules of a modular process that stopped. The down time it brought into the
          horizon counts as one stop before the first snapshot, also where the process is modular and all
          its modules stopped (`constraints.py:656-683`, PyPSA/PyPSA#2114)'
      Process_com_ext_p_lower:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_com_ext
        expression: Process_p >= ((Process_p_min_pu * Process_p_nom_ext) + (Process_big_m * Process_status))
          - Process_big_m
        description: '`Process-com-ext-p-lower` — a committed extendable process runs at least its minimum
          of the chosen build. Off, the big M releases the row'
      Process_com_ext_p_lower_nonneg:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_com_ext AND Process_p_min_pu_nonneg
        expression: Process_p >= 0
        description: '`Process-com-ext-p-lower-nonneg` — where no minimum-per-unit is negative, internal power
          is also plainly non-negative, a row the big-M lower cannot assert while the process is off'
      Process_com_ext_p_upper_big_m:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_com_ext
        expression: Process_p <= Process_big_m * Process_status
        description: '`Process-com-ext-p-upper-bigM` — off, a process does not run. On, the big M is no bound'
      Process_com_ext_p_upper_cap:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_com_ext
        expression: Process_p <= Process_p_max_pu * Process_p_nom_ext
        description: '`Process-com-ext-p-upper-cap` — a committed extendable process runs at most what is
          available of the chosen build, whatever its status'
      Process_com_mod_p_lower:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Process_p >= (Process_p_min_pu * Process_p_nom_mod) * Process_status
        description: '`Process-com-mod-p-lower` — a committed modular process runs at least its minimum of
          one module, whether the build is fixed or a decision'
      Process_com_mod_p_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Process_p <= (Process_p_max_pu * Process_p_nom_mod) * Process_status
        description: '`Process-com-mod-p-upper` — a committed modular process runs at most one module''s share,
          whether the build is fixed or a decision'
      Process_com_p_lower:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND NOT Process_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Process_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Process_p >= (Process_p_min_pu * Process_p_nom) * Process_status
        description: '`Process-com-p-lower` — a committed process runs at least its minimum. Off, it runs
          at least nothing'
      Process_com_p_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND NOT Process_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Process_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Process_p <= (Process_p_max_pu * Process_p_nom) * Process_status
        description: '`Process-com-p-upper` — a committed process runs at most what is available. Off, it
          runs at most nothing'
      Process_com_transition_shut_down:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed
        expression: Process_shut_down >= Process_previous_status - Process_status
        description: '`Process-com-transition-shut-down` — turning off is a stop, counted against the state
          the process carried into the snapshot'
      Process_com_transition_start_up:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed
        expression: Process_start_up >= Process_status - Process_previous_status
        description: '`Process-com-transition-start-up` — turning on is a start, counted against the state
          the process carried into the snapshot'
      Process_com_up_time:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND Process_min_up_time > 0
        expression: sum_back(Process_start_up, along=snapshot, window=Process_min_up_time) + Process_up_time_brought_in
          <= Process_status
        description: '`Process-com-up-time` — a process started within its own minimum up time is still on.
          The up time it brought into the horizon counts as a start before the first snapshot'
      Process_ext_p_nom_lower:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        where: Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_active_asset
        expression: Process_p_nom_ext >= Process_p_nom_min
        description: '`Process-ext-p_nom-lower` — the chosen build is at least its floor in every scenario'
      Process_ext_p_nom_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        where: Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_active_asset AND Process_p_nom_max
        expression: Process_p_nom_ext <= Process_p_nom_max
        description: '`Process-ext-p_nom-upper` — the chosen build is at most its cap in every scenario. A
          cap of infinity is no row'
      Process_p_nom_modularity:
        dims: [process]
        where: Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0 AND Process_active_asset
        expression: Process_p_nom_ext == Process_p_nom_mod * Process_n_mod
        description: '`Process-p_nom_modularity` — the chosen build is a whole number of modules'
      Process_p_ramp_limit_down:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: (Process_ramp_limit_down OR Process_ramp_limit_shut_down) AND NOT (Process_committable AND
          Process_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Process_p_nom_mod > 0)) AND Process_ramps_from_previous AND Process_active
        expression: Process_previous_p - Process_p <= Process_ramp_down_allowance
        description: '`Process-p-ramp_limit_down` — a process lowers internal power no faster than its ramp
          limit of the build. A committed one lowers it no further than its shut-down ramp in the snapshot
          it turns off. A process that came into the horizon running has a row at the first snapshot only
          where `p_init` gives the internal power it brought in. No process has one at the start of a later
          investment period, nor does any process a big M releases instead'
      Process_p_ramp_limit_down_run_big_m:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_com_ext AND (Process_ramp_limit_down OR Process_ramp_limit_shut_down) AND Process_ramps_from_previous
        expression: Process_p - Process_previous_p >= -Process_ramp_down_rate * Process_p_nom_ext - Process_big_m
          + Process_big_m * Process_status
        description: '`Process-p-ramp_limit_down-run-bigM` — a committed extendable process lowers internal
          power no faster than its limit of the chosen build. The big M releases the row in the snapshot it
          turns off'
      Process_p_ramp_limit_down_shut_big_m:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_com_ext AND (Process_ramp_limit_down OR Process_ramp_limit_shut_down) AND Process_ramps_from_previous
        expression: Process_previous_p - Process_p <= Process_shut_down_rate * Process_p_nom_ext + Process_big_m
          - Process_big_m * Process_shut_down
        description: '`Process-p-ramp_limit_down-shut-bigM` — in the snapshot it turns off, a committed extendable
          process ramps no further than its shut-down ramp of the chosen build. The big M releases the row
          everywhere else'
      Process_p_ramp_limit_up:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: (Process_ramp_limit_up OR Process_ramp_limit_start_up) AND NOT (Process_committable AND Process_p_nom_extendable
          AND NOT (Process_p_nom_mod > 0)) AND Process_ramps_from_previous AND Process_active
        expression: Process_p - Process_previous_p <= Process_ramp_up_allowance
        description: '`Process-p-ramp_limit_up` — a process raises internal power no faster than its ramp
          limit of the build. A committed one raises it no further than its start-up ramp in the snapshot
          it turns on. A process that came into the horizon running has a row at the first snapshot only where
          `p_init` gives the internal power it brought in. No process has one at the start of a later investment
          period, nor does any process a big M releases instead'
      Process_p_ramp_limit_up_run_big_m:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_com_ext AND (Process_ramp_limit_up OR Process_ramp_limit_start_up) AND Process_ramps_from_previous
        expression: Process_p - Process_previous_p <= Process_ramp_up_rate * Process_p_nom_ext + Process_big_m
          - Process_big_m * Process_previous_status
        description: '`Process-p-ramp_limit_up-run-bigM` — a committed extendable process raises internal
          power no faster than its limit of the chosen build. The big M releases the row in the snapshot it
          turns on'
      Process_p_ramp_limit_up_start_big_m:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_com_ext AND (Process_ramp_limit_up OR Process_ramp_limit_start_up) AND Process_ramps_from_previous
        expression: Process_p - Process_previous_p <= Process_start_up_rate * Process_p_nom_ext + Process_big_m
          - Process_big_m * Process_start_up
        description: '`Process-p-ramp_limit_up-start-bigM` — in the snapshot it turns on, a committed extendable
          process ramps no further than its start-up ramp of the chosen build. The big M releases the row
          everywhere else'
      Process_shut_down_p_fixed_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND NOT (Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Process_shut_down <= Process_modules_installed
        description: '`Process-shut_down-p-fixed-upper` — a stop is at most the modules in place, an explicit
          row as PyPSA writes it. The bound is one where the build is not modular, and the fixed build''s
          whole count of modules where it is'
      Process_shut_down_p_nom_variable_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Process_shut_down <= Process_n_mod
        description: '`Process-shut_down-p_nom-variable-upper` — a modular process stops only where a module
          is built'
      Process_start_up_p_fixed_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND NOT (Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Process_start_up <= Process_modules_installed
        description: '`Process-start_up-p-fixed-upper` — a start is at most the modules in place, an explicit
          row as PyPSA writes it. The bound is one where the build is not modular, and the fixed build''s
          whole count of modules where it is'
      Process_start_up_p_nom_variable_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Process_start_up <= Process_n_mod
        description: '`Process-start_up-p_nom-variable-upper` — a modular process starts only where a module
          is built'
      Process_status_p_fixed_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND NOT (Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0)
        expression: Process_status <= Process_modules_installed
        description: '`Process-status-p-fixed-upper` — a status is at most the modules in place, an explicit
          row as PyPSA writes it. The bound is one where the build is not modular, and the fixed build''s
          whole count of modules where it is'
      Process_status_p_nom_variable_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_committed AND Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0
        expression: Process_status <= Process_n_mod
        description: '`Process-status-p_nom-variable-upper` — a modular process is on only where a module
          is built'
    expressions:
      Bus_injection:
        dims: [bus, scenario, snapshot]
        expression: ((Generator_injection + Link_injection) + Load_injection) + Process_injection
        description: what every component puts into a bus, less what it takes out of it. PyPSA writes each
          term into the balance, and a load on its right-hand side
      Generator_injection: {expression: 'sum(Generator_sign * Generator_p, over=generator, by=Generator_bus[bus])'}
      Generator_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum((Generator_running_cost * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Generator_p * Generator_p)
          * Generator_marginal_cost_quadratic) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot)'}
      Generator_running_cost:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'what a generator''s output costs in a snapshot: the value read off its piecewise curve
          where it has one, and its linear `marginal_cost` otherwise. A curve replaces the linear cost, as
          PyPSA drops the unit from that term (`optimize.py:333-348`)'
        cases:
          curve: {when: Generator_marginal_cost_curve, expression: Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise}
        otherwise: Generator_p * Generator_marginal_cost
      Link_injection: {expression: '-sum(Link_p, over=link, by=Link_bus0[bus]) + sum(Link_output_arrival,
          over=link_output, by=Link_output_bus[bus])'}
      Link_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Link_p * Link_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Link_p * Link_p) * Link_marginal_cost_quadratic)
          * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link),
          over=snapshot)'}
      Link_output_arrival:
        dims: [link_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a link delivers to an output port at a snapshot. It is its flow delayed by the port's
          `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's efficiency at the snapshot
          the flow arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed flow wraps from the period's end.
          Where it is not, the flow still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that
          does not delay (`delay` zero) delivers its flow unshifted, cyclic or not
        cases:
          wrapping: {when: Link_output_cyclic_delay, expression: 'shift(at(Link_p, by=Link_output_link[link]),
              along=snapshot, offset=Link_output_delay, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period]) * Link_efficiency'}
        otherwise: shift(at(Link_p, by=Link_output_link[link]), along=snapshot, offset=Link_output_delay,
          edge=0, within=snapshot_period[period]) * Link_efficiency
      Load_demand:
        dims: [load, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a load draws from its bus's balance. It is its demand times its sign where it is
          active, and nothing where it is not. PyPSA drops an inactive load from the balance (`constraints.py:1591-1592`)
        cases:
          active: {when: Load_active, expression: Load_sign * Load_p_set}
        otherwise: '0'
      Load_injection: {expression: 'sum(Load_demand, over=load, by=Load_bus[bus])'}
      Process_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * Process_p_nom_ext * Process_capital_cost * Process_capital_weight)}
      Process_commitment_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Process_status * Process_stand_by_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=process), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((Process_start_up
          * Process_start_up_cost) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=process),
          over=snapshot) + sum(sum((Process_shut_down * Process_shut_down_cost) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=process), over=snapshot)'}
      Process_injection: {expression: 'sum(Process_output_arrival, over=process_output, by=Process_output_bus[bus])'}
      Process_modules:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: 'how many modules a committed process''s status counts: the chosen number where the build
          is extendable and modular, and the modules installed otherwise (`constraints.py:656-661`)'
        cases:
          chosen: {when: Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0, expression: Process_n_mod}
        otherwise: Process_modules_installed
      Process_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Process_p * Process_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=process), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Process_p
          * Process_p) * Process_marginal_cost_quadratic) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=process), over=snapshot)'}
      Process_output_arrival:
        dims: [process_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a process transfers at a port at a snapshot. It is its internal power delayed by
          the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's rate at the snapshot
          the transfer arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed transfer wraps from the period's
          end. Where it is not, the energy still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port
          that does not delay (`delay` zero) transfers at once, cyclic or not
        cases:
          wrapping: {when: Process_output_cyclic_delay, expression: 'shift(at(Process_p, by=Process_output_process[process]),
              along=snapshot, offset=Process_output_delay, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period])
              * Process_rate'}
        otherwise: shift(at(Process_p, by=Process_output_process[process]), along=snapshot, offset=Process_output_delay,
          edge=0, within=snapshot_period[period]) * Process_rate
      Process_p_carried_over:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the output a process carries over into a snapshot. At the first, it is the `p_init` it
          brought in, which is zero where it came in off. After that, it is the previous snapshot's
        cases:
          opening: {when: position(snapshot) == 0, expression: Process_p_init}
        otherwise: shift(Process_p, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      Process_p_nom_committed:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: 'the build a committed process''s ramp rows are taken against: one module where the build
          is modular, since its status counts modules, and the given build otherwise (`constraints.py:1131-1134`)'
        cases:
          modular_build: {when: Process_p_nom_mod > 0, expression: Process_p_nom_mod}
        otherwise: Process_p_nom
      Process_p_nom_effective:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: 'the build a process''s limits are taken against: the chosen one where it is extendable,
          the given one otherwise'
        cases:
          extendable: {when: Process_p_nom_extendable, expression: Process_p_nom_ext}
        otherwise: Process_p_nom
      Process_previous_p:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'the output a process carries into a snapshot. It is nothing at the first snapshot it
          is active in past the first of the horizon: PyPSA fills an output it did not build with zero (`constraints.py:716`).
          It is the output carried over otherwise'
        cases:
          opening_late: {when: 'position(snapshot) > 0 AND NOT shift(Process_active, along=snapshot, offset=1)',
            expression: '0'}
        otherwise: Process_p_carried_over
      Process_previous_status:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the commitment state a process carries into a snapshot. It is off at the first snapshot
          it is active in past the first of the horizon. PyPSA reads a status it did not build as off there
          (`constraints.py:391`). It is the state carried over otherwise
        cases:
          opening_late: {when: 'position(snapshot) > 0 AND NOT shift(Process_active, along=snapshot, offset=1)',
            expression: '0'}
        otherwise: Process_status_carried_over
      Process_ramp_down_allowance:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: how far a process may lower internal power between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit
          of the build while it stays on, plus its shut-down ramp in the snapshot it turns off
        cases:
          committed: {when: Process_committable, expression: Process_ramp_down_rate * Process_p_nom_committed
              * Process_status + Process_shut_down_rate * Process_p_nom_committed * (Process_ramp_previous_status
              - Process_status)}
        otherwise: Process_ramp_down_rate * Process_p_nom_effective
      Process_ramp_down_rate:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the ramp limit in a process's down row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_down`. It is the full build
          where PyPSA has none, since a shut-down ramp alone builds the row
        cases:
          given: {when: Process_ramp_limit_down, expression: Process_ramp_limit_down}
        otherwise: '1'
      Process_ramp_previous_status:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the status a committed process's ramp rows carry into a snapshot. At the first snapshot,
          a fixed modular process that came in running has every module on, since the state it brought in
          is on or off (`constraints.py:1152-1157`). The transition and down-time rows count it as one module
          (PyPSA/PyPSA#2114). It is the state carried in otherwise
        cases:
          opening_modules: {when: position(snapshot) == 0 AND NOT Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_p_nom_mod
              > 0, expression: Process_status_initial * Process_modules_installed}
        otherwise: Process_previous_status
      Process_ramp_up_allowance:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: how far a process may raise internal power between two snapshots. It is its ramp limit
          of the build while it stays on, plus its start-up ramp in the snapshot it turns on
        cases:
          committed: {when: Process_committable, expression: Process_ramp_up_rate * Process_p_nom_committed
              * Process_ramp_previous_status + Process_start_up_rate * Process_p_nom_committed * (Process_status
              - Process_ramp_previous_status)}
        otherwise: Process_ramp_up_rate * Process_p_nom_effective
      Process_ramp_up_rate:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the ramp limit in a process's up row, PyPSA's `ramp_limit_up`. It is the full build where
          PyPSA has none, since a start-up ramp alone builds the row
        cases:
          given: {when: Process_ramp_limit_up, expression: Process_ramp_limit_up}
        otherwise: '1'
      Process_shut_down_rate:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: the shut-down ramp in a process's down row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_shut_down`), or the full
          build where it has none
        cases:
          given: {when: Process_ramp_limit_shut_down, expression: Process_ramp_limit_shut_down}
        otherwise: '1'
      Process_start_up_rate:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: the start-up ramp in a process's up row (PyPSA's `ramp_limit_start_up`), or the full
          build where it has none
        cases:
          given: {when: Process_ramp_limit_start_up, expression: Process_ramp_limit_start_up}
        otherwise: '1'
      Process_status_carried_over:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'the state a process carries over into a snapshot: the state it brought into the horizon
          at the first, the previous snapshot''s after that'
        cases:
          opening: {when: position(snapshot) == 0, expression: Process_status_initial}
        otherwise: shift(Process_status, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      risk_weighted_opex: {expression: 'sum(scenario_weight * scenario_opex, over=scenario)'}
      scenario_opex:
        dims: [scenario]
        expression: ((Generator_opex + Link_opex) + Process_opex) + Process_commitment_opex
        description: 'what a future costs to run: every operating term, weighted by the snapshot''s hours
          and its period, before the scenario''s own weight. A start and a stop cost what they cost, unweighted,
          as PyPSA adds them (`optimize.py:448-468`)'
      total_cost:
        dims: []
        expression: Process_capex + risk_weighted_opex
        description: what the system costs. Capacity counts once per active period at its expected cost over
          the scenarios. Operation counts in expectation over the scenarios, and a share of it at the tail
    conditions:
      Generator_marginal_cost_curve: {condition: 'count(Generator_marginal_cost_curve_p, over=breakpoint)
          > 0 AND Generator_active_asset', description: 'a generator that pays along a piecewise `marginal_cost`
          curve: one of PyPSA''s `active_assets` with curve data (`optimize.py:307`, `piecewise.py:230-257`)'}
      Process_com_ext: {condition: Process_committable AND Process_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Process_p_nom_mod
          > 0) AND Process_active, description: 'a committable process with an extendable, non-modular build
          that is active in the snapshot''s period. These are PyPSA''s `com-ext` rows, whose status is relaxed
          against the chosen build'}
      Process_committed: {condition: Process_committable AND Process_active, description: 'a committable process
          that is active in the snapshot''s period: every unit-commitment row''s set'}
      Process_ramps_from_previous: {condition: 'position(snapshot, within=snapshot_period[period]) > 0 OR
          (position(snapshot) == 0 AND (Process_status_initial == 0 OR Process_p_init))', description: 'a
          snapshot whose ramp uses a previous output. It is any snapshot but its period''s first, and the
          horizon''s first where the process comes in off or carries an initial output'}
    objective: {sense: minimize, expression: total_cost}
    ```

    The prep — every table the spec declares, from the network — and the solve:

    ```python
    from differential.pypsa.prep import relation, static, varying, weighting


    n = build()  # the network from the PyPSA tab

    sources = {
        'bus': pl.Series('bus', list(names(n.buses.index).astype(str)), dtype=pl.String),
            **{
                dim: pl.Series(dim, list(names(n.static(component).index).astype(str)), dtype=pl.String)
                for component, dim in DIM.items()
            },
            **scenarios(n),
            **periods(n, multi),
            **carriers(n, multi),
        'snapshot': pl.Series('snapshot', list(timesteps(n)), dtype=pl.Datetime('us')),
        'Generator_bus': relation(n, 'Generator', 'bus'),
        'Link_bus0': relation(n, 'Link', 'bus0'),
        'Load_bus': relation(n, 'Load', 'bus'),
        'Bus_attached': attached(n),
        'Generator_sign': per_component('Generator', first_scenario(n.generators['sign'])),
        'Load_active': per_component('Load', first_scenario(loads['active']), bool),
        'Load_p_set': varying(n, 'Load', 'p_set'),
        'Load_sign': per_component('Load', first_scenario(loads['sign'])),
        'snapshot_weightings_objective': weighting(n, 'objective'),
    }

    with sps.solve('differential/pypsa/rungs/rung_26_committable_process.yaml', sources) as result:
        result.objective  # 15865.125
    ```

=== "PyPSA"

    The network, `rung_26_committable_process.py` in the corpus — the spine plus what this rung adds:

    ```python
    # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: mathspec Contributors
    #
    # SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

    """Rung 26: committable processes — rung 25's committable links restated as processes that draw a quarter more than they deliver."""

    from __future__ import annotations

    import spine


    def build():
        """The spine plus an east bus that only committable processes serve."""
        n = spine.build()
        n.add('Bus', 'east')
        n.add(
            'Process',
            'warm_conv',
            bus0='north',
            bus1='east',
            rate0=-1.25,
            committable=True,
            p_nom=60,
            p_min_pu=0.3,
            marginal_cost=8,
            min_up_time=3,
            min_down_time=2,
            up_time_before=1,
            ramp_limit_up=0.5,
            ramp_limit_down=0.5,
            ramp_limit_start_up=0.6,
            ramp_limit_shut_down=0.6,
            start_up_cost=100,
            shut_down_cost=50,
            stand_by_cost=5,
        )
        n.add(
            'Process',
            'cold_conv',
            bus0='north',
            bus1='east',
            rate0=-1.25,
            committable=True,
            p_nom=40,
            p_min_pu=0.2,
            min_up_time=2,
            min_down_time=3,
            up_time_before=0,
            down_time_before=1,
            start_up_cost=20,
        )
        n.add(
            'Process',
            'ext_conv',
            bus0='north',
            bus1='east',
            rate0=-1.25,
            committable=True,
            p_nom_extendable=True,
            p_nom_max=30,
            capital_cost=5,
            p_min_pu=0.2,
            marginal_cost=2,
            up_time_before=0,
            ramp_limit_up=0.5,
            ramp_limit_down=0.5,
        )
        n.add(
            'Process',
            'mod_conv',
            bus0='south',
            bus1='east',
            rate0=-1.25,
            committable=True,
            p_nom_extendable=True,
            p_nom_mod=10,
            p_nom_max=40,
            capital_cost=3,
            p_min_pu=0.5,
        )
        n.add(
            'Process',
            'mod_fix',
            bus0='north',
            bus1='east',
            rate0=-1.25,
            committable=True,
            p_nom=20,
            p_nom_mod=10,
            p_min_pu=0.5,
            marginal_cost=1,
        )
        n.add('Load', 'east_load', bus='east', p_set=[20, 70, 60, 5])
        return n
    ```

    ```python
    n = build()
    n.optimize(solver_name='highs')
    n.objective  # 15865.125
    ```
